b: Home / Blog / Business Setup Business Setup How to Register a Private Limited Company with the SECP: Step-by-Step Guide By the Kamboh Technologies team 4 November 2026 7 min read In short To register a private limited company in Pakistan, you apply online to the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) . The main steps are: choose the company type, reserve the company name, prepare the documents and director details, file the incorporation application, and receive the certificate of incorporation. After incorporation, register the company with the FBR for a National Tax Number (NTN). Registration is not the end: companies must file annual returns with the SECP and tax returns with the FBR every year. Registering your business as a private limited company gives it a separate legal identity, makes it easier to open business bank accounts and sign contracts, and builds trust with clients. In Pakistan, companies are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) under the Companies Act, 2017. Here is how the process works. Step 1: Choose the right company type The two most common options for small and growing businesses are: Private limited company : at least two members and two directors. Suitable for partners or founders starting together. Single member company (SMC) : one person owns the company, with a nominee named in case something happens to the owner. By the Kamboh Technologies team 4 November 2026 6 min read In short The cost of a mobile app in Pakistan depends mainly on scope : how many features it has and how complex they are. Other big factors are one platform or two, the design, the backend and admin panel, integrations such as payments, testing and store approval, and maintenance after launch. A cross-platform framework such as Flutter usually lowers cost, because one codebase runs on both iPhone and Android. Launching a focused first version (an MVP) is the most reliable way to control cost and get to market sooner. “How much will my app cost?” is the first question almost every business asks, and the honest answer is: it depends on what the app needs to do . Two apps that look similar on the surface can take very different amounts of work behind the scenes. This guide explains the main factors so you can plan a realistic budget and compare quotes fairly. 1. The number and complexity of features Features are the biggest driver of cost. A simple information app with a few screens is very different from an app with user accounts, payments, live tracking and a chat system. Each feature needs design, development, testing and ongoing maintenance. A useful exercise is to list every feature and mark it as must-have or nice-to-have .
